title: Game
description: Play casual eight-ball with two people sharing one device. Aim, set your power and take turns at the table.

title: Solar System
description: Explore NASA models and original asteroid models in an animated Solar System. Select a body, adjust time speed and compare two display scales. Circular orbits are illustrative, not an ephemeris.

title: Product Studio
description: Inspect original fictional packaging studies: a food tin and a beverage can. Explore illustrative component states and reset the product.

title: Shelf Inspector
description: Explore an original modular retail shelf. Highlight shelves, toggle emissive LED strips, edit a concept header and compare four manual detail levels.

title: Chibi Motion Studio
description: Direct the mall visitor through a walk, wave, nod or idle pose. Pause and scrub each movement from any angle.

title: Tripo Chibi Motion Studio
description: Explore seven Tripo character clips, from a quiet idle to a jump, dance and run in place. Pause or scrub to see each pose.

title: Modular Chibi Dress-Up
description: Swap hair, tops and shoes, then add a hand gesture while your chibi moves.

title: Marina Bay to Johor Bahru
description: Drive a small car along the real road route from Marina Bay Sands over the Causeway to Johor Bahru, with a border checkpoint on the way.

title: Singapore Heartland
description: Walk round a small Singapore heartland district as your chibi: HDB blocks, a hawker centre, shops and a playground around a ring road.

title: Singapore Open World
description: Drive a car with real physics through the OpenStreetMap road network and buildings around Marina Bay, starting at Marina Bay Sands.

title: Singapore MRT Station
description: Watch a train come into an MRT platform, stop at the screen doors, open its doors and leave; stand on the platform, ride inside or look from above.
